analysis: future-endpoint minimal principal-angle transport of phase-local post-GELU activation frames
basis: deterministic phase-start and phase-end post-GELU PCA on disjoint fit and holdout token windows
decision_rule: select the smallest rank for which both disjoint activation windows recover at least 2.5x the registered random 32-stage Givens aggregate, every pilot cell recovers at least 1.5x, and forward transport is at least 1.25x the positive reverse-direction control
operator: minimum-displacement orthogonal T carrying the phase-start activation subspace to the phase-end subspace; predict c_proj endpoint as W0 @ T.T
